returnInterest.note: I would like to return and do a road trip through the Baltics to explore more of the nature and historic towns.

description.intro: Latvia is one of the three Baltic countries and is known for its forests, historic sites, and long cultural history. So far I have only visited the capital, Riga, but I enjoyed my time there. From what I saw, the country has beautiful nature, interesting history, and food that I would happily return for. Although I probably wouldn't return to Riga specifically.
standouts: I enjoyed learning about the history.
culturalNotes: I found it interesting that many supermarkets sold beer in large plastic bottles, something you don't ever see in Western Europe.

travelPracticalities.visaNotes: I did not need a visa.
paymentNotes: Both card and cash payments were widely accepted.
transportNotes: Most rental companies in the Baltics charge extra fees for crossing international borders, which can be around €100 per border.
languageNotes: Latvian is a Baltic language and is closely related to Lithuanian.
I found the English level in Riga to be quite good.

notes: The weather was a little on the colder side, but I liked it.
The red and orange colours of the forests were beautiful.

foodNotes: I enjoyed the food, especially the different kinds of Pončiki.
I found very affordable food and beer at the markets.
I thought the beer was quite good.

regionsOverview.name: Riga
notes: This is the only part of Latvia I have explored so far.
I found it more expensive than I expected.
The markets offered very affordable food and beer.
